title: Portfolio Throughput Analysis
methodology: Direct pack-file parse via Function constructor. S307/S308 artifacts consumed. REVISION_HISTORY session velocity analysis.

velocityItemsPerSession.500-series_ENHANCED: 7 cases (42 items) per session — ~16 items/session including review
velocityItemsPerSession.800-series_Wave1: BLOCKED — DL-008 confirmed 0 actual items. No Wave 1 needed.
velocityItemsPerSession.800-series_Wave2+: Estimated ~18 items/session per S308 capacity model

certification.limitingFactor: Structural readiness — items must pass CAQS §1.6 audit before certification. 167 Domain E items are 77% archived clones (need re-audit). Domain F 149 items are wholly unprocessed (never seen audit).
certification.sessionSavingsIfResolved: DL-008 resolution alone saves 3 sessions. Domain E parallelization with F could save 3-5 more.

ewAuthoring.velocityItemsPerSession: ~39 for case-bank items (S308 estimate). ~36-40 for MCQ items.
ewAuthoring.limitingFactor: Case-bank EW starting from near-zero (3.9% fill). No factory model — authoring is ad-hoc per-certification-wave. 2,403 total missing slots.
ewAuthoring.sessionSavingsIfResolved: EW factory model (Agent O) could double velocity. Pre-built EW templates for clone rotation items could reduce 2 sessions.

governance.velocityItemsPerSession: Attestation: 1 session per certification wave. REVISION_HISTORY: 1 entry per session (~0.2 sessions equivalent).
governance.limitingFactor: Serial attestation process. Each wave requires separate governance gate.
governance.sessionSavingsIfResolved: Merged attestation (batch governance across waves) could save 1-2 sessions.

modernization.velocityItemsPerSession: Clone reduction: ~382 items/session. DL-013: ~425 items/session. DL-031: ~250 items/session.
modernization.limitingFactor: All 129 archived Domain E items are DL-012 rotation-artifacts. Re-auditing them is high-friction (must re-derive CC, verify distractors, re-author EC). Clone rotation audit for Pack C/D Section E/F is the primary modernization volume.
modernization.sessionSavingsIfResolved: Deferring all modernization (DL-013, DL-031, EC normalization) to post-cert saves 10 sessions with ~6.5 UIQS point deferred quality gain.

biggestLimitingFactor: DOMAIN E ARCHIVED CLONES — 129 of 167 Domain E gap (77%) are DL-012 archived rotation clones. These cannot be batch-processed because each requires independent CC re-derivation, distractor audit, and EC authoring. They gate Domain F (149 unprocessed items in same packs/sections). Total bottleneck: 316 items across Packs C/D Sections E/F.

defer_modernization.confidence: HIGH — modernization is quality polish, not safety

recommendedPriority: 1) Drop DL-008 phase entirely (save 3 sessions). 2) Front-load Domain E Section E certification (Packs C/D — 167 items). 3) Run Domain F certification in parallel with later Domain E stages. 4) Defer all modernization to post-certification. 5) Adopt EW factory model for case-bank.
